livingCosts.notes: UM Department of Social and Preventive Medicine 'International Student-life' page, 'typical monthly budget breakdown' for a single international student (RM1,500-2,500 a month excluding tuition), midpoints of its ranges: housing = accommodation RM400-800 + utilities/internet RM100-200; food RM600-900; transportation RM100-200; personal expenses RM200-400. UM's International Student Centre site (isc.um.edu.my) could not be reached, and Study@UM only links to the government EMGS cost-of-living page. Page undated, read 2026-09-30.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering
programmes.notes: Study@UM programme page, international tuition fee RM132,100 for the whole programme (academic session 2025/2026 intake onwards, 'based on minimum or common period of study'), divided by 4 years (8 semesters + 1 special semester). Excludes the 6% Sales and Service Tax the page says applies to international fees, and any registration/service fees, which UM does not publish for international students. UM says fees are subject to change, so not cohort-locked. No 2024/2025 fee schedule was found, so no fee history.
